prompt: A majestic storm-wolf the size of a summit boulder, its whole mane and tail a permanent corona of blinding white-gold lightning, deep storm-blue coat rippling with static, eyes burning like the eye of a thunderhead.

name: Stormray
prompt: A flat, wide indigo manta-ray-like creature gliding with wing-fins tipped in pale storm-gold, small sparks flickering off its trailing tail, bright alert eyes on a smooth rounded head.

name: Squallray
prompt: A slightly broader indigo ray with brighter gold static crackling along its wing edges, its tail now trailing a faint spark-trail as it glides.

name: Thunderfin
prompt: A sleek deep-indigo ray whose wing-fins have grown longer and sharper, laced with visible branching lightning along the leading edge, gold sparks streaming off every wingbeat.

name: Zephyrmanta
prompt: A large glowing ray, deep near-black indigo, its vast wings now edged in a constant crown of crackling gold-white lightning, twin light-trails streaming from its wingtips in flight.

name: Maelray
prompt: An immense storm-ray gliding like a living thundercloud, deep indigo-black body wreathed head to tail in blinding white-gold lightning arcs, wings so wide they seem to blot out the sky behind them.

name: Haloling
prompt: A small pale ghost-light drifting in a soft cream-gold glow, a thin halo ring floating just above it, faint wisps trailing like a candle flame; two gentle glowing eyes.

name: Haloglow
prompt: A slightly larger drifting ghost-light, its halo ring now solid and brighter gold, its cream-white form trailing longer wisps of warm light.

name: Sanctilume
prompt: A softly glowing spirit with a wider, more defined golden halo and two smaller light-rings orbiting its trailing wisps, its form a richer warm gold-cream.

name: Seraphume
prompt: An elegant light-spirit wreathed in three nested golden halo rings and long trailing streamers of warm light, its glowing core now a deep radiant gold.

name: Empyrion
prompt: A magnificent being of layered golden halos and streaming light-wings, its core blazing like a captured sunrise, trailing warmth and soft radiance in every direction.

name: Wardenshade
prompt: A tall spectral armoured warrior, pale blue-white plate armour over a translucent ghostly frame, wielding a glowing cyan blade, faint mist trailing from its cloak; steady glowing eyes beneath a worn helm.

name: Wardenwraith
prompt: A slightly taller spectral knight, its pale armour now etched with faint glowing cyan runes, cloak trailing longer wisps of mist, blade burning a touch brighter.

name: Sentinelshade
prompt: An imposing armoured spirit with a more ornate pale helm and pauldrons traced in glowing cyan sigils, its whole form more solid yet still edged in drifting mist, blade wreathed in light.

name: Highward
prompt: A towering armoured guardian spirit in elaborate pale-violet plate etched entirely in luminous cyan sigils, a long ghostly cloak streaming like banners, blade blazing bright and steady.

name: Duskwarden
prompt: A magnificent spectral warden in resplendent violet-silver armour wreathed in glowing cyan runes from helm to greaves, a vast trailing cloak of living mist, and a blade that burns like captured starlight.

name: Tidesinger
prompt: A serene jellyfish spirit floating upright, a translucent cyan-white bell trailing long luminous ribbon-tendrils that curl like sheet music, and a faint halo of sea-glass light above its crown — its whole body glows softly from within like moonlight caught on water.

name: Sylvan Hart
prompt: A radiant white-gold stag with antlers of living light branching into soft mint-green leaf clusters and a pale cream coat dappled with faint sun-dapples, walking as if trailing pollen with every step — gentler and more luminous than Mossbuck, closer to a blessing than a beast.

name: Prism Wyrm
prompt: A slender violet-blue dragon whose body is faceted like cut crystal, with wings of translucent prism-glass that split light into faint rainbows and a crown of pale quartz shards over its brow, trailing broken shards of light behind it.

name: Verdant Rex
prompt: A small, round-bodied dino spirit wrapped in soft moss and new spring leaves with huge gentle amber eyes and a faint green nimbus around its rounded back — the forest's kindness given a shy, huggable shape.

name: Ember Totem
prompt: A carved wooden tribal mask given life, glowing amber cracks running through dark bark-like skin, with twin plumes of gentle orange flame rising from its crown like feathers — warm and ancestral rather than fierce.

name: Deepcaller
prompt: A stately blue-skinned sea sovereign with a finned crest and long trailing fins like ceremonial robes, glowing turquoise runes pulsing along its arms in time with an unheard song, built broad and calm enough to ride.

name: Mire Prince
prompt: A regal indigo frog-prince draped in tattered violet lantern-light with a faint drowned-lantern glow along its throat and fingertips and a crown woven from marsh reeds — melancholy and elegant rather than menacing.

name: Dune Titan
prompt: A broad ochre-skinned desert titan built like an old standing stone, sand perpetually sifting off its shoulders in a slow golden veil, with small glowing cracks of amber light along its knuckles and brow.

name: Storm Seraph
prompt: A winged golden wraith wrapped in a tattered storm-cloud cloak, a faint crackling halo of lightning behind its skull-light head — softly glowing gold where Stormcrown burns jagged and cold.

name: Thornjaw Rex
prompt: A towering forest-green dinosaur bristling with thorned vines fused into its hide and a maw ringed in wooden spikes, roaring with pollen bursting from its throat — the Vale's fury given teeth, dwarfing any evolved line.

name: Ashen Totem
prompt: A house-sized tribal mask of cracked grey ash-wood, glowing ember-orange fissures spider-webbing across its face and twin curling horns of smouldering charcoal, radiating a constant heat-shimmer.

name: Abyssal Tyrant
prompt: A hulking indigo-blue demon of the deep lake, rows of pale bioluminescent markings down a scaled hide, with an unsettling second reflection of itself shimmering just behind its silhouette.

name: Bog Sovereign
prompt: An ancient crowned frog-king the size of a house, moss-green hide streaked with drowned-lantern violet glow, a crown of waterlogged lanterns ringing its brow — sat low and heavy, like a throne given legs.

name: Sandjaw Colossus
prompt: A colossal sand-gold tyrannosaur crusted in fossilised dune-stone plating, jaws wide enough to swallow a caravan, trailing a perpetual sandstorm off its spine and tail.

name: Stormcrown
prompt: A vast crowned wraith of storm-cloud and bone, a jagged golden crown fused to a skull-white head, lightning forking permanently between its ribs and its trailing cloak.

name: Bellwyrm
prompt: An immense deep-blue serpent-guardian armoured in barnacle-crusted plates, bronze drowned bells growing from its spine that seem to sway on their own, glowing teal fins fanned like sails along its length.

name: Elder Stag
prompt: A towering ancient stag with bark-brown fur and antlers vast enough to hold up a canopy, moss and mushrooms and a lime-green glow clustered through the rack where Mossbuck's antlers only hint at it — the great-grandparent of every forest deer in the Vale.

name: Geode Colossus
prompt: A mountain-sized slate-violet golem whose entire back has cracked open into one vast geode, bristling with cyan and gold crystal formations that crackle faintly with storm-light through the stone joints.

name: Aether Sovereign
prompt: A colossal indigo storm-dragon crowned in pale gold horns and a floating halo, its body plated in glowing amber crystal shards that drift and orbit it like a private storm system — the calm, terrible authority of something that has judged every Guardian before it.
